values.summary: Freeze typed media and redaction contracts, implement the Deepgram adapter and registry wiring, prove it with deterministic loopback tests and one minimal live round trip, document downstream use, resolve exact-head review, and publish one closing PR.

steps.action: Define typed synthesis, transcription, media, provenance, credential, and error contracts plus canonical Deepgram profiles.
Implement the Deepgram batch HTTP adapter and profile-based speech-provider factory.
Add deterministic loopback tests, opt-in live canary, redacted receipt, and focused provider documentation.
Run focused validation, resolve independent exact-head review, publish, shepherd, and finish truthfully.

invariants: No credential value or authorization header enters durable state or user-visible errors
Successful synthesis bytes match declared encoding and container
Successful transcription includes explicit provider and model identity
Request identity excludes text, audio bytes, and credential material
Deepgram speech support does not imply completion support
risks: Provider-profile reuse could accidentally imply completion support
HTTP diagnostics could expose authorization data
Weak media checks could accept HTML or JSON error bodies as audio
Live canary evidence could retain source text or audio
Deepgram response schema drift could be mistaken for an empty transcript
stop_conditions: The implementation requires credentials in tracked files or command arguments
The provider can send a real credential to an unapproved host
Live proof cannot retain a fully redacted receipt
Scope expands into realtime streaming, episode rerendering, or broad provider refactoring
